title: Pinned functorial relative Mayer--Vietoris triangle comparison
statement: For a cartesian square of schemes with affine bases and the compact two-open hypotheses of the relative Mayer--Vietoris construction, the source and target pinned relative Mayer--Vietoris triangles admit a morphism of distinguished triangles whose first component is relativeMVGlobalArrow, middle component is the biproduct of the two local arrows, and third component is the overlap relativeMVLocalArrow.

proof.text: Apply the functorial Mayer--Vietoris triangle construction on the source and inverse-image covers, then transport the vertices through derived pullback/direct-image composition and right-adjoint mate comparisons.
Use naturality of units and counits and the pinned base-change mate to identify the global, middle, and overlap components with the displayed relative arrows.

lean.statement:
theorem relativeMV_pinned_triangle_comparison
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    {X S X' S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (hpull : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory X) (K' : schemeDerivedCategory X')
    (φ : (derivedPullback g').obj K ⟶ K')
    [IsAffine S] [IsAffine S'] [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (hK : schemeDerivedQCohProperty X K) (hK' : schemeDerivedQCohProperty X' K')
    (U V : X.Opens)
    (hUqc : IsCompact (U : Set X)) (hVqc : IsCompact (V : Set X))
    (hUVqc : IsCompact ((U ⊓ V : X.Opens) : Set X)) (hcover : U ⊔ V = ⊤) :
    let a := relativeMVLocalArrow f f' g g' hpull K K' φ
    let aX := relativeMVGlobalArrow f f' g g' hpull K K' φ
    ∃ (δ : (a (U ⊓ V)).left ⟶ aX.left⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧)
      (δ' : (a (U ⊓ V)).right ⟶ aX.right⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧),
      Triangle.mk (relativeMVSourceFirst f g U V K)
        (relativeMVSourceSecond f g U V K) δ ∈ distTriang (schemeDerivedCategory S') ∧
      Triangle.mk (relativeMVTargetFirst g' f' U V K')
        (relativeMVTargetSecond g' f' U V K') δ' ∈ distTriang (schemeDerivedCategory S') ∧
      ∃ m :
        Triangle.mk (relativeMVSourceFirst f g U V K) (relativeMVSourceSecond f g U V K) δ ⟶
        Triangle.mk (relativeMVTargetFirst g' f' U V K')
          (relativeMVTargetSecond g' f' U V K') δ',
        m.hom₁ = aX.hom ∧ m.hom₂ = biprod.map (a U).hom (a V).hom ∧
        m.hom₃ = (a (U ⊓ V)).hom
